budget.rationale: Cash $12,260–$16,770; high end exceeds $15k. United Economy airfare was observed at $6,097.66 for four, but lodging and rental remain unquoted, so the planning band and low overall budget confidence are retained.

weather.rationale: Retained June Sicily climatology is warm and mostly dry; heat breaks remain essential.

fireRisk.rationale: Retains the documented moderate Sicily June planning band; not an exact-date forecast.

swim.rationale: Repeated Ionian swims plus four Cefalù nights; historical coastal water about 72–74°F, with pools requested but unconfirmed.

variety.rationale: Three distinct coastal bases, Greek and Baroque history, volcanic terrain and an optional cliff walk get real time.

ease.rationale: Three four-night bases and no internal flights; one 3–3½-hour drive, ZTLs and a one-way rental prevent an easy 4.

food.rationale: Pizza, pasta, sandwiches and groceries in every base; named current menu checks supplement the retained south-coast picks.

risk.rationale: Exact four-person flights reached United checkout, but the 64-minute Montréal connection is tight, early PMO rental return remains unquoted, and Etna access is conditional. Two flex days protect activities; final fare and ticket rules still require review.

nights.rationale: 12 hotel nights give 5/5 under the shared rubric.

novelty.rationale: Sicily does not overlap the documented family visited-place list.

pto.rationale: Nine weekdays including departure, after observed Juneteenth; employer holiday policy must match. Zero default weight.

routeProfiles.name: Sicily in June
routeProfiles.rationale: Sicily is highly fire-prone and the July 2026 island-wide emergency confirms that the consequence can be severe. Timing matters: the regional 2023 analysis found no critical fire conditions from early summer through mid-July before a sharp late-July surge. June is meaningfully safer than July, but not low-risk.

value.aggregation: The trip inherits the lowest safety score among its route profiles so one exposed base cannot be hidden by a low-risk base.
value.monitoring: Recheck official daily fire-danger maps and active incidents 14 days, 72 hours, and each morning before a rural drive or hike. A live red/extreme warning overrides this climatology.

sourceLocators.sicily-fire-history-2023: Regional report pp. 14–17: no critical June/early-July phase; July 24 surge; 74,341 hectares burned in Sicily in 2023
